key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
AUD weakened sharply on growth scare; oil 'exploded' as price suppression failed, fuel prices set to rise 30c
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating rate-cut trajectory
ANZ.AX restructuring: 3,500 jobs axed, chief's turnaround plan still early
Housing: high-end prices crashing while affordable segment resilient; no spring auction bounce
China's 70% EV target threatens long-term oil demand, offsetting short-term price spike
Mining cap-raise wave led by Canaccord signals capital stress in junior sector
Superannuation reform debate intensifying with One Nation proposals and structural critiques
Australia softened local gas supply rules, easing Asian energy security fears (Santos.AX relevant)

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; ASX miners led the $90bn weekly sell-off. Junior miners scrambling for cap raises via Canaccord-led deals. Gold underperforming ('gold schmould').
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from falling iron ore. Juniors (PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources) showing relative strength but liquidity risk. Avoid over-exposure to iron ore names short-term.

sectors.trend: Negative. Banks sent ASX tumbling alongside miners. ANZ.AX post-3,500-job cut still in early turnaround. Rising bond yields and mortgage rate spikes ahead of CPI data pressure net interest margins.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face margin compression risk if RBA holds rates. ANZ restructuring may take 12-18 months to show P&L benefit. Watch for credit cycle deterioration signals.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-positive short-term. Oil 'exploded' as suppression failed; fuel prices rising 30c. However, China's 70% EV target is a structural headwind. Australia softened gas supply rules, supporting Santos.AX.
sectors.implications: Santos.AX, Woodside.AX benefit from gas policy easing. Oil majors see short-term upside but EV transition caps medium-term. Fuel cost inflation pressures consumer staples.

sectors.trend: Under pressure. Woolworths.AX caught raising 'family staple' prices during a 'Price Freeze' promo, damaging brand trust. Rising fuel and input costs squeeze margins. Women's clothing chain closing 177 stores signals weak discretionary spend.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin and sentiment headwinds. Defensive positioning in staples still valid but earnings quality under scrutiny.

sectors.trend: Divergent. High-end property seeing steepest falls; affordable segment resilient. No spring auction bounce. RBA worried about rental inflation. NZ correction still running. Leith Van Onselen warns of further housing price falls.
sectors.implications: REITs (GP.AX, SPG.AX) face rental yield compression risk. Residential developers under pressure. First-home buyer surge may support volume but not prices.

sectors.trend: Selective strength. Renalytix.AX +7% on UBS upgrade and CEO buying. HIVE.AX scaling AI cloud via BUZZ HPC. ASX runners: Iondrive, Australasian, Aruma, Neurizon. But broader equity fund outflows on inflation fears.
sectors.implications: Niche tech/AI names showing idiosyncratic strength. Broad tech underperforms as investors rotate to defensives. Small-cap liquidity remains thin.

key_themes: Oil price spike vs. China EV structural demand shift creating energy sector tension
AUD weakness amplifying import inflation and RBA policy dilemma
Iron ore downturn pressuring ASX's largest weightings
Housing market bifurcation: luxury correction vs. affordable resilience
Superannuation reform political risk (One Nation proposals)
Mining sector capital stress and cap-raise dilution risk
RBA rental inflation concern delaying rate-cut expectations

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil-driven inflation resurgence delaying RBA rate cuts
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, property developers) with short-duration bonds; monitor RBA statements for hawkish pivot

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse hitting ASX 200 earnings
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold (GOLD.AX) and critical minerals (CRB.AX) for diversification

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD weakness triggering capital outflows and import inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight domestic-revenue companies; use AUD hedges on overseas exposures

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction spilling into broader credit cycle
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor bank NIM and credit loss provisions; avoid high-LVR residential REITs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mining junior cap-raise dilution and liquidity risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid small-cap miners without confirmed offtake; prefer large-cap producers with balance sheet strength
Review super fund exposure; favour diversified, low-fee funds less exposed to political risk

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Australian gas producers on policy easing
opportunities.rationale: Softened local gas supply rules reduce export restriction risk; Asian demand supportive; Santos.AX undervalued post-policy shift

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into critical minerals and battery tech
opportunities.rationale: China EV transition creates structural demand for lithium, rare earths; Critical Resources battery tech passing month-long tests; less correlated to iron ore cycle

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap tech on idiosyncratic catalysts
opportunities.rationale: Renalytix.AX UBS upgrade and insider buying signal; HIVE.AX AI cloud scaling; ASX runners showing momentum
ANZ.AX restructuring pain is front-loaded; CBA.AX, NAB.AX benefit from higher-for-longer rates on NIM; 3,500-job cut signals management commitment

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore exposure; hedge with gold
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; gold underperforming now but offers diversification if oil-driven inflation persists

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim high-end property and residential REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest price falls at luxury end; RBA rental inflation concern may delay cuts, pressuring valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash buffer; avoid leveraged positions
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD weakness, oil volatility, and $90bn ASX drawdown signal elevated uncertainty; preserve capital for entry points

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-cautious. ASX likely to consolidate lower as oil-driven inflation fears and iron ore weakness persist. RBA on hold with rental inflation concern limits rate-cut catalyst. AUD remains vulnerable. Expect volatility around US CPI data. Key support for ^AXJO near recent lows; a break could trigger further selling.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. China EV transition supports critical minerals and battery supply chains. Australian gas policy reform benefits energy majors. Housing correction may create entry points in 6-12 months. Superannuation system, despite political noise, remains structurally sound. ANZ and bank sector turnarounds should deliver by H2 2027.
key_catalysts: US CPI data (imminent) – will confirm or deny oil-driven inflation spike
RBA statement on rental inflation and rate path
Iron ore contract price trajectory (BHP/RIO/FMG earnings impact)
China EV adoption data vs. oil demand forecasts
Australian gas supply rule implementation details
Superannuation policy debate (One Nation vs. government response)

Brent crude and Australian fuel pump prices
RBA cash rate and rental inflation data
ANZ.AX, CBA.AX NIM and credit metrics
ASX small-cap cap-raise volume and dilution
US CPI and bond yield movements
China EV sales data and 70% target progress
